description: Source file for the Popup_Picker class, which handles displaying a popup list of activities such as tasks, meetings, calls, emails, and notes within the SuiteCRM (SugarCRM derivative) platform. It retrieves linked records, processes activity data, and renders a Smarty template for the popup interface.

classes.name: Popup_Picker
classes.description: Handles fetching and displaying activity records linked to a module, rendering a Smarty template with a categorized list of activities for selection.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for Popup_Picker class, initializes the object.

methods.name: process_page
methods.description: Main method that retrieves linked activities, processes them, and renders the popup Smarty template.

methods.name: getEmailDetails
methods.description: Generates a detailed string of email addressing info, including To, From, CC, and description.

methods.name: getTaskDetails
methods.description: Returns formatted task details including start date and description.

methods.name: formatDescription
methods.description: Converts text descriptions to HTML with nl2br.
